findings.summary: the repeated-container-aware glTF load count was recomputed in three places; all scene material and mesh creation-order metadata now uses currentGltfAssetCount

node-material block-loader validation repeated Babylon package prefixes and TypeScript wrapper unwrapping; it now derives prefixes from babylonPackages and shares the existing unwrapExpression helper with hierarchy validation

SpriteRenderer.layers native-vector provenance was lost through local bindings and ignored by one consumer, producing an invalid Array reference or needless conversion; the marker now survives aliases, binds with the native type, and one helper serves picking and renderer creation

imported-root reparent state was split between an identity token and a compiler-global side table while component and set writes duplicated refusal branches; the alias-shared token now carries the boolean directly and each reachable mutation path checks it once

mesh and transform-node parenting repeated child-link erase/find/push bookkeeping and set_asset_root_parent copied the whole imported mesh vector; shared link helpers now own the bookkeeping and imported roots iterate their mesh list directly

repeated glTF containers reparsed and recomposed source-invariant renderable features and materials; composition now caches those pure results by shared asset identity while retaining per-container ordering, material bases, and renderable variants

the bounded Scene 117 continuation could register its settle gate only after native frame-zero capture had already become eligible; capture now starts at frame one and the exact two-RAF waits retain native capture gates, restoring exact gold-tint parity

the exact imported-node DFS proof unnecessarily tied absence to undefined and rejected the established racer helper's equivalent null sentinel; the closed validator now accepts both nullable spellings while retaining the same traversal and ambiguity refusals
